choices.why: A modern light grey three-seat sofa with slim legs, sized at 204 cm to sit comfortably centered on the long left wall without crowding the room.
At 200x300 cm it is the only rug big enough to anchor the whole seating area, and its plain light flatweave keeps the room bright and is easy to live with when hosting.
A pale ash coffee table with tapered legs: exactly the light wood requested, and its simple Scandinavian shape suits a modern room.
A low cream console on a wooden base that keeps the TV wall light and pairs with the wood of the coffee table.
A black arc lamp that reaches over the sofa from the corner, echoes the black balcony frames and gives warm light for evenings with friends.
Two textured mustard cushions bring the requested pop of color to the grey sofa and pick up the brass legs.
A tall, airy areca palm fills the spot by the balcony door and makes the most of the light there.
A pair of white light-filtering panels on a slim rod softens the large sliding door while keeping the room luminous.

answer.why: A light palette of grey, cream, pale wood and white keeps the room bright and modern. Black accents tie in with the balcony frames, and the mustard cushions and green palm add warmth and color for receiving friends.
